title: Court names Mango tycoon's son as suspect in probe into father's death
summary: The son of Isak Andic, founder of fashion group Mango, was named by a judge in Barcelona on Tuesday as a suspect in an investigation into his father's death in a 2024 cliff-top fall. Jonathan Andic, 45, was arrested ⁠and questioned by police in Catalonia, before later being released after posting 1 million euros in bail. France 24’s correspondent in Madrid…
